name: Director Storyboard
description: Generate a complete Director storyboard from a single creative brief.

stages.name: Outline scenes
stages.prompt: Given the creative brief, produce a numbered list of 4-6 scenes. Each scene needs a setting, mood, and key action.

stages.name: Generate storyboard
stages.prompt: For each scene from the previous stage, write a Director storyboard entry with shot type, camera move, and 1-line VO.
